name: Rockslugs

unlocks.name: Slug Salter
unlocks.notes: Rockslugs are automatically dealt the finishing blow if the player has a bag of salt in their inventory. Cost was reduced from 80 to 10 points in the Summer Sweep Up update (27 August 2025).

variantInfo.name: Rockslug
notes: NPC ids 421/14423/422; 27 Hitpoints, Defence 27 (all styles 0), max hit 4 crush, 4-tick.
To kill a rockslug you must throw a bag of salt on it while it has 4 or fewer Hitpoints, or wield a brine sabre (which removes the salt requirement).
25% weakness to earth spells; a light source is required in both caves.

locationComparison.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (rockslugs)
notes: Seven rockslug spawns in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon; a light source is required.
A cannon cannot be placed in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (cannon prohibited-areas list); multicombat is not wiki-stated (conservative false).

locationComparison.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
notes: Five rockslug spawns in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves; a light source is required and open flames are extinguished by swamp gas.
A Dwarf multicannon can be used here.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 301 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Rockslugs is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Assigned only by Mazchna (30-50) in this dataset; requires Slayer level 20.
A bag of salt must be thrown on a rockslug at 4 or fewer Hitpoints to kill it, unless a brine sabre is used; requiredItemId 4161 is Bag of salt (wiki item infobox id).
25% weakness to earth spells; a light source is required in both the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

fremennik-slayer-dungeon base file is a basilisk file (safeSpot/konarLockable true); this family uses a tuned copy fremennik-slayer-dungeon-rockslugs. lumbridge-swamp-caves is referenced by id (owned by cave-bugs, CT-L shared #1).
recommendedMethod: Bring a light source and a stack of bags of salt. Whittle each rockslug down with any melee weapon and throw a bag of salt once it reaches 4 or fewer Hitpoints to finish it; a brine sabre removes the salt requirement entirely. Earth spells exploit the 25% earth weakness for Magic training. The Lumbridge Swamp Caves allow a Dwarf multicannon.
